messages:
Anya M: Quick heads-up — Cobalt-13B-QL landed in model-registry. Need rapid bring-up & priority decision. Short checklist: quant smoke, chat template + tool-call contract, sanity evals (safety/medical), perf baselines. Who can pick up benchmarks? :eyes:
Mike R: I can run perf/latency sweeps on dedicated pool. baseline plan: 500 prompts, contexts 512/2048, measure p50/p95/p99 + tokens/sec. I'll add int8 and q4f16 profiles.
Simon L: I'll own prompt formatting and structured-output contract. Proposed schema (function-call style):
```
{"name":"respond","type":"object","properties":{"answer":{"type":"string"},"evidence":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}}}}
```
Simon L: also want an example chat template for tool calling — short one:
```
User: "What's the diagnosis?"
Assistant: (call:extract_symptoms)
Tool(extract_symptoms) -> {"symptoms":["fever","cough"]}
Assistant: "Based on {symptoms} ..."
```
Eva K: fyi eval dashboard shows 4.2% drop on med-q3 vs ember-14b in first pass. We should gate if >3% regression. Recommend human spot-checks for top-20 failures. :rotating_light:
Anya M: Agree — gate policy: no >3% drop on critical evals, and no safety-tier failures. Mike, can you produce perf numbers + quant regressions by EOD? Simon, add schema to the intake ticket.
Mike R: On it. Kicking off int8 on prod-gpu-2, q4f16 next. I'll post a short CSV in #eng-ml-bench when done.
deploy-bot: model cobalt-13b-ql uploaded successfully (id: mdl_cka1) at 1751234572
Oncall Bot: quick lint for chat-template passed
Anya M: Thanks — I'll update the intake PR with owners and checklist. tagging @Simon L and @Mike R. :thumbsup:
Simon L: one question — do we want to enable prefix KV-cache for chat-to-tool flows? could help latency.
Mike R: yes, enable automatic kv-cache for context>1024, I'll include config snippet in bench post.
Anya M: perfect. wrapping up — owners: Simon (schema/format), Mike (quant/perf), Eva (eval gating), Anya (release gate).
